basis: Gulf margins check (2026-10-25): every 2022 ITIC value is imputed (OBS_STATUS I, ITIC-MODELLED), and on routes not into the USA the ITIC crude (HS 2709) and product (HS 2710) rates run about 2.5-3x the measured US Census 2022 import charges of the same exporters (SAU crude into the USA 2.15% in Census, ITIC 2.13%; ITIC SAU to CHN 7.04%, on half the haul) and 2022 tanker freight. The tanker part of crude (routes not in energy_route_modes.csv) and the sea part of pet take the exporter region's Census 2022 rate, m = (con_cif - con_val) / con_val over HS 2709 or 2710 (IMDB hs6_cty_rp_2022); an exporter with less than 0.1 bn of US customs value takes the value-weighted rate of all exporters but Canada. On a route to an importer outside the Americas (S01 gtap_geo NAMR, CAMR, SAMR, CARB) an exporter's own rate is floored at that fallback, because its US rate reflects its haul to the USA and short-haul or overland US suppliers (MEX, COL, CAN products, the Caribbean) would otherwise carry it to Europe and Asia (S16 review 2026-10-25; our choice). Crude pipelines, the road and air parts, gas (271111 LNG has almost no US imports) and every route into the USA keep ITIC. Output energy_sea_rates_s08.csv, hard check S08-H13, flag ENERGY-SEA-CENSUS. Method text: GTAP 7 ch.9A p.3 (margins from US bilateral import charges; the GTAP 12 margins chapter is not in the repo). Using the exporter's US rate on its routes to every importer is our choice, not in GTAP text. itic = the ITIC rate unchanged. Beta v4 G5 (Grok QA, Cursor 3; 2026-10-26): the Census charge (con_cif - con_val) covers the whole route in every mode, so it was wrong to use it as the sea part only (m = sea x Census + rest x ITIC added 0.89 bn on oil and 2.66 bn on pet over Census). Under us_census_exporter_hs4_whole_route the route's margin outside crude pipelines is the Census rate, spread over the modes by the prior shares; the crude pipeline part (rdt share of oil) keeps ITIC (GTAP 7 ch.9A p.3). S08-H13 now re-reads the Census rate from the IMDB file. Alternatives: us_census_exporter_hs4 (sea part only, as in beta v3) and itic.
